name: 蘇倚德
objective:
無論就量而言或就質而言，債編均為民法中最為重要之部分。本課程旨在向修課同學介紹關於民法債編之生活實用法律知識，包含下列重點：
一、民法債編之背景及理論
二、民法債編之解釋
三、民法債編於案例事實之適用

參與本課程乃理解民法債編及民法整體之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。


"Obligations" is the most important part of the Civil Law, not only in quantity but in quality. This course aims to give participants a general introduction to "Obligations", including "General Provisions for Obligations" and "Kinds of Obligations". Furthermore, the introduction contains the following four points: 
1. Background and theories of "Obligations".
2. Interpretation of "Obligations".
3. Application of "Obligations" to the facts.

Attending this course is the critical step to understanding "Obligations" and the Civil Law as a whole, and it benefits participants a lot.
